title: NLRC Evidence Webbot
desc: Capture NLRC case pages, mail evidence, attachments, and UTF-8 conversions with WKAppBot.
steps: Open the NLRC index page, not the raw list.do endpoint.
Fill the case number input and keep cmitCd=00, agtYn=N, pageIndex=1, and recordCountPerPage=10.
Trigger the search button or its AJAX handler; do not use direct GET navigation.
Save the rendered DOM with web html and the rendered text with web read.
Record mail thread bodies, attachment names, sizes, and download links in Markdown.
Store every artifact as UTF-8 and convert each document type before saving summaries or Markdown snapshots.
Maintainer sync (2026-05-01): HQ copy is authoritative.
author: claude
